requiresEveryCondition: at least one distinct crop cluster improves
at least one distinct Brand design improves
all source and model hashes verify
no concealed confidence or abstention assumption

NO_EVIDENCE_OF_GAIN.when: no crop-cluster improvement, or no design improvement, without a material design regression

whenAnyOf: a comparison that cannot be interpreted without changing the frozen design

designRegressionRule: Any material regression within a repeated Brand design makes that design a regression. An improvement within the same design does not cancel it.
cropClusterRule: The duplicate C1 crop counts once.
aggregationRule: No averaging may conceal an item-level material regression.
keepAuthorizes: a separately planned expanded held-out benchmark
keepDoesNotAuthorize: production Python or ONNX Runtime dependencies

priorConclusionsPreserved.pr214: REGRESSION for PARSeq-small versus incumbent Tesseract. Unchanged and not reinterpreted by this experiment.
priorConclusionsPreserved.pr215: COMPATIBLE for the PP-OCRv6-small ONNX compatibility probe. Unchanged and not reinterpreted by this experiment.
